notes: Population: 2,840 payloads (SatType 'P') launched in 2024 that reached orbit, from GCAT satcat, satcat100k, auxcat and tmpcat; each payload counted once. Excluded: 36 (launch-failure 20, marginal-launch 4, non-standard-PX 12); not in the catalogs at all: 21 standard payloads lost in failed launches (ftocat).

Reconciliation: adding the excluded launch-failure, marginal-launch and suborbital payloads back gives 2,864 payloads and 2,625.4 t TotMass, McDowell's own counting method (his stats page: 2,864 payloads, 2,625.9 t).

Launch year = GCAT LDate (UTC) of the carrying launch; ISS/carrier deployments keep the launch year of their cargo flight. Station-deployed payloads: 24; payloads without an own orbit that use their parent's (ISS/deployer/carrier) orbit: 0.

Orbit classes from the canonical orbit: SSO = Polar/SSO (apogee < 2,000 km, i >= 85°); LEO = other apogee < 2,000 km; GTO/GEO = GEO/GTO/HEO/VHEO, apogee >= 30,000 km, e >= 0.5 or period >= 23 h; MEO = other Earth orbits; Beyond = lunar, heliocentric or escape (Status DSO/DSA, deep-space OpOrbit).
Mass = GCAT 'Mass' (wet mass at orbit insertion, excl. attached objects; TotMass not used to avoid double counting). 0 masses imputed (0.0%); 302 (10.6%) are McDowell's own '?' estimates (~±20 %).

Customer rules (first match wins): captive/Starlink: lead owner UCode SPXS (SpaceX Starlink) = 1962; captive/Starlink: Bus 'Starshield' (NRO proliferated, SpaceX-built and -launched) = 106; captive/Kuiper / OneWeb: owner UCode KUIP or ONEWEB, or Program Kuiper/OneWeb = 20; captive/China: State CN/HK/MO = 266; captive/Russia: State RU = 98; institutional-us: NASA Commercial Crew/Cargo spacecraft with a commercial owner = 7; institutional-*: lead owner org class C/D = 95; institutional-*: lead owner A/B but psatcat payload class C/D = 6; open-commercial: remaining class A/B owners = 280.
European institutional = governments/agencies of EU-27, UK, NO, CH, IS, LI plus ESA, EU, EUMETSAT; Other governments = all other non-US, non-CN/RU states.
Andøya band = inclination within [90, 110.6]° (any orbit class): 406 sats (14.3%); open market (excl. captive) 219 of 388; open market <= 700 kg 210 of 326.
Segments: (customer, group, orbit class, 2° inclination bin [lo, hi), mass class with inclusive upper bound); avgMassKg = mean mass of the payloads in the segment, massKg = their total.
Data reflect what flew (historic launches), not addressable future demand; captive = flies on in-house or pre-contracted launchers by policy or contract.
